description: Who bought and sold this token in the last 1-24 hours? The top 10 buyers and top 10 sellers by size on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, each labeled: the deployer, wallets funded by it or by its funder, snipers (bought in the first minute of trading), fresh wallets, exchanges, contracts, and wallets that launched tokens we recorded and how many lost liquidity. Summary like '4 of the top 10 buyers are linked to the deployer'. Not advice. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.
name: token_who_bought
